content: {"episode_id":"ep-05002","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.91) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9). As the note states, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment given the need to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies. We therefore request reconsideration of the denial on the basis of medical necessity as documented in the ordering indication."}
